name: AhaLoader
summary: The full-surface branded loading screen shown while a new environment boots — workspace → editor, or editor → presenting.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-loader> — the branded loading SCREEN for an environment transition (landing in the editor, opening the presenting view). It fills its container on a white ground and cycles five branded illustration tiles with a staggered soft-flow: each tile fades + slides + unblurs in, holds, then fades out, so exactly one is prominent at a time. REUSE, not rewrite — the five graphics are the shared <aha-illustration> spot art (loader-award / loader-wand / loader-plane / loader-ballot / loader-chart), called BY NAME, never an inline <svg>. Shadow-DOM CSS themed only by --aha-* tokens → byte-identical in React and Vue; the loop is a decorative keyframe whose easing binds to the --aha-ease-* motion tokens and stills under prefers-reduced-motion. This is the full-screen SCREEN — for an inline indeterminate spinner reach for <aha-spin>.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) and Vue both render <aha-loader> directly via attributes. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design; the five tiles are the DS's own <aha-illustration> spot art (registry family `loader`), never redrawn here. Make the host's container full-screen for a real environment transition.

spec.label: Ground
spec.value: white full-surface (--aha-white); fills its container, min-height 240px

spec.label: Tiles
spec.value: five 120×120 rounded tiles (radius-xl 16), each centred, one prominent at a time

spec.label: Art
spec.value: reused <aha-illustration> spot art at 96px — loader-award · loader-wand · loader-plane · loader-ballot · loader-chart

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: soft-flow keyframe · 7.5s loop · 1.5s stagger across the five · easing --aha-ease-in-out

spec.label: Reduced motion
spec.value: prefers-reduced-motion stills the loop and holds one branded tile

spec.label: Duration
spec.value: override the loop length via the CSS custom property --aha-loader-duration (default 7.5s)

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name announced by the role=status live region (e.g. "Opening the editor…")

whenToUse.when: a full-screen environment transition — the user lands in a new surface (workspace → editor, editor → presenting) and waits for it to boot
an inline, indeterminate wait inside an existing surface — a button, a panel, a section loading in place
the layout of the content being loaded is known — show its shape rather than a spinner

opinion.note: One AhaLoader per transition, filling the whole surface. It is decorative brand motion, not a progress bar — don't pair it with a percentage. Keep the `label` a short present-tense phrase naming the destination ("Opening the editor…").
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — ported from the product Loader (stpancras-storybook UI/AhaLoader): a white full-screen screen cycling five branded icon-cards with a staggered soft-flow (7.5s loop, 1.5s stagger). Bindings: tile 120×120 radius-xl 16 (snapped onto the DS scale from the source 14), art the reused <aha-illustration> loader-* family at 96, easing --aha-ease-in-out. a11y: host role=status + aria-live=polite + aria-label from `label`; the loop stills under prefers-reduced-motion, holding one tile.

snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Probes the white ground, the five 120×120 radius-xl tiles, and that all five tiles mount (reused <aha-illustration> spot art). Animated properties (opacity/transform/filter) are NOT measured — geometry, colour and radius are stable across the loop.
